Whereas Akt and ERK1/2 both stimulate mTOR to a similar extent, their combined effects lead to an even greater stimulation compared to either alone (305). Moreover, the two pathways appear to be synergistic to satellite cell function; ERK1/2 stimulates cell proliferation, and PI3K facilitates differentiation (101).
